arxiv-master-search 0.1.0 Changelog

- Initial public release with comprehensive arXiv paper search, download, and analysis capabilities.
- Supports keyword, author, date range, and category-based searches with flexible CLI parameters.
- Enables batch PDF downloads and metadata extraction in multiple formats (JSON, BibTeX, CSV, RIS).
- Provides batch search via JSONL files and automated summary generation for retrieved papers.
- Outputs organized into structured directories for PDFs, metadata, and summaries.
- All functionalities accessible via command line; no config file required.
